## Release / release-please

This repo uses **release-please**. Avoid merge commits whose title is `Merge pull request #…` (not Conventional Commits).

**Merge:** **Squash and merge** with a conventional squash title (`fix:`, `feat:`, …) or **Rebase and merge** if all commits are conventional.

**Commit types:** `fix:` / `feat:` drive semver bumps by default.

## Checklist

- [ ] Merge strategy matches release / changelog intent
